title: Average over padded edge slots
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $G$ be an undirected multigraph with vertices indexed by $	ext{Fin}(n)$ and degree $2^{	ext{size}(n)}$, and let $f$ assign a rational number to each vertex. For any vertex $v$, the sum of $f$ over the neighbors in the slots indexed from $0$ to $2^{	ext{size}(n)}-1$, with out-of-range slots contributing $0$, divided by $2^{	ext{size}(n)}$, equals the sum of $f$ over all edge slots at $v$ divided by the degree.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is an undirected multigraph on $	ext{Fin}(n)$ of degree $2^{\text{size}(n)}$
